report.summary: Most claims are supported by the cited pages. Several partial verdicts arise when a single tag is used for a sentence containing multiple facts that span different pages (e.g., revenue percentage vs order book, strengths split across pages). One untagged claim regarding total borrowings and short-term debt percentage needs a citation. Overall sourcing is solid but could be tightened by splitting multi-fact sentences into separate citations.
